subject: Architecture workshop: align ML/infra agenda & lock 60–90m
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Chen <andrew@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Architecture workshop: align ML/infra agenda & lock 60–90m

Hi Andrew — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps.

Recap (very brief)
- Primary goals: validate end-to-end inference latency targets, seed batching/caching strategy, and review network/isolation needs for HIPAA-sensitive payloads.
- Current ask from Helio: a hands-on architecture workshop with our ML infra engineers (60–90 minutes) to walk through serving topology, routing/fallback, and ops playbook.

Proposed workshop windows (PT) — please pick one that fits your roster:
- Option A: Tue Sep 22, 2026 — 14:00–15:30 PT (90 min)
- Option B: Wed Sep 23, 2026 — 09:00–10:30 PT (90 min)
- Option C: Thu Sep 24, 2026 — 11:00–12:00 PT (60 min) — if you want a tighter, focused session.

Draft agenda (we can adjust)
1) 10 min: Introductions + goals review
2) 20 min: Serving architecture (Marissa) — kernels, batching, quantization tradeoffs
3) 15 min: Smart routing & fallbacks (Karthik) — cost vs latency policies
4) 20 min: Ops & observability (Mina) — tracing, token-level cost, rollback/playbooks
5) 15–25 min: Live Q&A and short demo (model load, cache warmup)

Attachments: discovery notes and a one-page workshop outline attached for your review (20260911-discovery-notes.pdf, redwood-workshop-outline.pdf).

Asks for your team
- Confirm preferred slot (A, B or C) and timezone adjustments if needed.
- Who from Helio should join? (please share names + roles: infra/ML engineering, security/compliance, product).
- Any must-cover questions (SOC2 evidence, data residency, audit logs, etc.) so we can prep artifacts and invite the right SME.

I can send a calendar invite once you confirm a slot. If you want procurement on the thread later, we can bcc them after the technical alignment.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

[Attachment: 20260911-discovery-notes.pdf] [Attachment: redwood-workshop-outline.pdf]

From: Andrew Chen <andrew@heliohealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lopez <sarah@heliohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Architecture workshop: align ML/infra agenda & lock 60–90m

Karthik — thanks for the clear recap. Option A (Sep 22, 14:00 PT) works best for us. Please tentatively book that slot.

Attendees from Helio:
- Andrew Chen — Head of ML Engineering (me)
- Sarah Lopez — Lead Platform Engineer (cc'd)
- We'd likely add one security contact after we check internal schedule (name TBD).

Quick asks so your team can prep:
- We will want to see any SOC 2-related logs/audit capabilities around inference (does Redwood surface token-level audit trails?)
- Are there recommended pre-reads we should share with our infra team so the session is productive?

If Sep 22 is tentatively reserved, we will confirm by end of day Monday once we lock internal security attendance.

Best,
Andrew
Andrew Chen
Head of ML Engineering, HelioHealth
andrew@heliohealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Chen <andrew@heliohealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Architecture workshop: align ML/infra agenda & lock 60–90m

Thanks Andrew — happy to lead the technical portion. A few notes from the Redwood infra side: 
- We will cover serving topology, continuous batching, KV/prefix caching, and how we select optimized kernels for different sequence-length distributions.
- We can include a short live demo (5–10 min) showing cache-warmup benefits and a quick trace from request->token emission if you want concrete latency numbers.
- SOC2 / audit: Karthik — would you pull the SOC2 evidence summary and the audit-log export example? I can surface the tracing examples and token-cost breakdown.

Suggested internal attendees from Redwood (please add to the calendar invite):
- Marissa Cole — Lead Solutions Engineer (will run the workshop)
- Mina Haddad — Observability & Ops lead (will demo traces & alerts)
- Karthik Iyer — Sales Engineer (facilitator & routing policy owner)

If Helio prefers a 60-min focused session instead of 90, we can trim the demo and Q&A to keep it targeted.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Lead Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround, Andrew. Sep 22, 14:00–15:30 PT is tentatively held on our side. I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm security's attendance.

Notes / next steps we will action now:
- Marissa and Mina will prepare the demo trace export and a short one-page SOC2 evidence summary for the session (attached examples above).
- Please share the final Helio attendee list by EOD Monday so we can tailor the ops section.
- If you want us to include a 10-min procurement pre-read for commercial terms (commits, burst capacity), let me know and I'll attach it to the invite for your procurement colleague.
